title: I paid for Claude Pro because of the Fable 5 demos. Big mistake !!!!
author: CuriousDivide5546

comments.author: monsterfurby
comments.body: Are we complaining that it isn't one-shotting a very complex type of game now? Geeee-sus. Come on, no model ever is going to save you from doing at least \*some\* workflow guidance.

replies.author: CycleMother2006
replies.body: You'll want to build feature by feature for something complex... Not one shot entire thing. Additionally, you're going to find that while it has definitely improved on visual / spatial quality, it is still its weakest avenue and  will likely continue to be for a long time. Anything that requires visual QC it's going to struggle with and take a lot of iterating.
